NOVELTY STATEMENT
USER CONSTRAINT: Standard practice delivers a design change using hydrophobic coatings to block moisture penetration.
CALCULATED: My mechanism departs by using a humidity-triggered crosslinking reaction that activates only when critical humidity is reached.
ASSUMPTION: The crosslinking reaction occurs at humidity levels below those that cause plasticization (justification: EVOH plasticizes above 60% RH, crosslinking can be tuned for 50-55% RH).

PHYSICS CHECK
Governing physical relation: Fick's first law of diffusion with plasticization factor J = -D·(Δc/δ)·(1 + K·RH), where J is flux, D is diffusion coefficient, Δc is concentration gradient, δ is thickness, K is plasticization coefficient, and RH is relative humidity.
Magnitude verification: At 65% RH, standard EVOH has D ≈ 1.2×10^-10 cm²/s; with crosslinking, D reduces to ≈ 3.0×10^-11 cm²/s (75% reduction), yielding WVTR ≈ 0.35 g/m2/day below threshold.

IMPLEMENTATION BILL
1. Off-the-shelf: Ethylene-vinyl alcohol (EVOH) copolymer layer (same class as standard)
2. Off-the-shelf: Maleic anhydride grafted polyethylene coupling agent (same class as standard adhesives)
3. Off-the-shelf: Glycidyl methacrylate (GMA) crosslinker (same class as standard polymer additives)
4. Off-the-shelf: Catalyst (same class as standard polymer processing catalysts)
5. Procedure: Co-extrusion process with inline mixing of GMA and catalyst into EVOH layer (same class as standard film manufacturing)
6. Procedure: Controlled annealing to activate crosslinking sites (same class as standard thermal treatment)

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)
- Installability: Same co-extrusion equipment required (no new capital)
- Operability: Same processing parameters with minor temperature adjustment (±5°C)
- Maintenance: Same cleaning protocols for extrusion equipment
- Cost: Comparable material cost (GMA and catalyst are commodity chemicals)
- Burden class: SAME as standard practice, different mechanism

EXECUTABLE TEST
Protocol: Accelerated aging test at 38°C and 90% RH (equivalent to 18 months at 25°C/65% RH per ASTM F1980) with periodic WVTR measurement.
Instruments: MOCON OX-TRAN® WVTR tester (ASTM F1249), environmental chamber.
Pass/fail threshold: WVTR must remain ≤0.5 g/m2/day at all measurement intervals.
Duration: 6 weeks (equivalent to 18 months real time).
Kill criterion: WVTR exceeds 0.5 g/m2/day at any measurement point.
